metadata.title: TRAITÉ DE LA CHALEUR CONSIDÉRÉE DANS SES APPLICATIONS

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Didot or Bodoni), which was prevalent in French publishing during the 18th and 19th centuries.
